info.name: Radiology Appointment Management System
info.description:
All API endpoints for the radiology appointment management system.

Base URL: `http://localhost:4000/api/v1`

## Authentication

All endpoints except `POST /auth/register` and `POST /auth/login` require a JWT.

1. Run **Auth > Register** or **Auth > Login** first — the returned token is saved automatically to the collection variable `token`.
2. The collection uses Bearer auth, so every other request sends `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.

Without a valid token, protected endpoints return:

```json
{ "success": false, "statusCode": 401, "message": "Access denied. No token provided.", "data": null }
```

(or `"Invalid or expired token."` for a bad/expired token).

## Response shapes

Most successful responses use the shared `ApiResponse` shape:

```json
{ "success": true, "statusCode": 200, "message": "Success", "data": {} }
```

Zod validation errors (global error handler) use:

```json
{ "success": false, "statusCode": 400, "message": "msg1 & msg2", "errors": ["msg1", "msg2"] }
```

Controller errors use `ApiResponse` (`data: null`, no `errors` array).

## Known quirks (mirrors the current implementation)

- Creates for categories, branches, partners and reservations respond with **HTTP 200** while the body carries `"statusCode": 201` (only `POST /auth/register` really returns HTTP 201).
- `PUT /categories/:id` and `PUT /branches/:id` not-found responses use **HTTP 400** with body `"statusCode": 404`.
- `PUT /radiologies/:id` with a valid but missing id returns **HTTP 200**, `"message": "radiology updated successfully"`, `"data": null` (no 404).
- `DELETE /branches/:id` with an invalid id returns the typo message `"invalid brunch id"`.
- Unknown paths (with a valid token) return `{ "status": "error", "message": "route not defined", "code": 404 }`.
- Most `GET` list endpoints accept `search/page/limit/sort/order` query params (validated, so bad values still 400) but only `GET /branches` actually applies filters — and there `name` / `availableRadiology` are exact-match filters while `page`/`limit`/`search`/`sort`/`order` are forwarded into the Mongo query (so avoid them on branches).

item.name: Categories
item.description: CRUD for radiology categories. Categories are referenced by radiologies, partners (profit share) and branches (available radiology).

request.description: Returns all categories. Accepts (but ignores) `search/page/limit/sort/order` query params — invalid values still return 400.

response.name: Invalid Query Parameter

request.description:
Body:
- `name` (string, required — must be a string; empty string passes validation)

Returns HTTP 200 with body `statusCode: 201`.

response.name: Already Exists
Validation Error (missing name)

request.description:
Path param `id`: valid ObjectId of the category.
Body: `{ "name": string }` — no zod validation on this route.
Deletes the category and all radiologies belonging to it. Returns 204 No Content.

item.name: Radiologies
item.description: CRUD for radiology exams. Each radiology belongs to a category. Prices live on branches, on each branch's `availableRadiology` entry (`price` + `salePrice`).

request.description: Returns all radiologies with `category` populated. Accepts (but ignores) `search/page/limit/sort/order` query params.

Body:
- `name` (string, required, min 1)
- `category` (string, required, valid category ObjectId — existence is not checked)

response.name: Validation Error (invalid payload)

request.description: Partial update — send any fields present on the radiology model (`name`, `category`). A valid but non-existent id returns HTTP 200 with `data: null` (there is no 404 branch).

response.name: Missing ID returns success with null data

item.name: Branches
item.description: CRUD for clinic branches. Branches hold a work schedule, available radiologies (each entry has a `price` and `salePrice`) and a list of reservations.

request.description:
Populates `availableRadiology.radiology` (each entry keeps `price` and `salePrice`) and `reservations` (full documents).

Query filters: `name` and `availableRadiology` are exact-match Mongo filters. `search/page/limit/sort/order` are accepted but forwarded into the Mongo query as field names — avoid them here.

response.name: Success

request.description: Returns a single branch with `availableRadiology.radiology` and `reservations` populated.

response.name: Success

request.description:
Body:
- `name` (string, required, min 3, unique)
- `address` (string, required, min 3)
- `availableRadiology` (array, optional — entries: { radiology, price, salePrice })

Returns HTTP 200 with body `statusCode: 201`.

item.name: Partners
item.description: CRUD for partners with per-category profit share percentages.

request.description: Populates `profitShare.category`.

Body:
- `name` (string, optional)
- `profitShare` (array, required): each item `{ category: ObjectId, value: number }`

Returns HTTP 200 with body `statusCode: 201`. Note: the duplicate check does not `return`, so a duplicate name can still be persisted after the 400 is sent.

response.name: Created
Already Exists
Validation Error

request.description: No zod validation on this route. `profitShare` items are merged by `category`: existing categories get updated values, new categories are appended. `name` is only updated when present.

item.name: Clients
item.description: Read-only client endpoints. Clients are created automatically when a reservation is created.

request.description: Populates `reservations`.

item.name: Reservations
item.description: Appointments. A reservation is created together with (or reuses) a client, and is linked to branch + partner + radiologies.

request.description: Populates `client`, `branch`, `radiologies` and `fromPartner`. Accepts (but ignores) `search/page/limit/sort/order/state/date` query params.

response.name: Success

request.description:
Body:
- `date` (string, required, ISO datetime)
- `notes` (string, optional)
- `branch` (string, required, branch ObjectId)
- `radiologies` (string[], required, radiology ObjectIds — empty array is allowed by validation)
- `fromPartner` (string, required, partner ObjectId)
- `clientName` (string, required)
- `clientAge` (number, required)
- `clientPhone` (string, required)

If a client with the same `clientName` already exists, that client is reused. Returns HTTP 200 with body `statusCode: 201` and default message `"Success"`.
